dct_title_s: Damage assessment  in Roxas town, Palawan province, Region IV-B (Mimaropa), Philippines  as of 21 December 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20211216PHL** This map illustrates potentially damaged structures/buildings in Roxas town, Palawan province, Region IV-B (Mimaropa) of Philippines as observed from a Pleiades image acquired on 21 December 2021 after landfall of the Tropical Cyclone RAI-21. Within the analysis extent, UNITAR-UNOSAT identified 280 damaged structures and 265 potentially damaged structures including Roxas Medicare Hospital and 6 potentially damaged education facilities. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
